extDescription.message: Hides your personal details and blocks secrets before you send a prompt to ChatGPT or Gemini. Real details stay on your device.

badge_off.message: MIRAGE is paused. Click to turn on.

badge_found.message: $N$ items will be hidden before sending.

badge_found_one.message: 1 item will be hidden before sending.

badge_secret.message: This prompt has a secret. It won't be sent.

preview_footer.message: $N$ items hidden · real details stay on this device

preview_footer_one.message: 1 item hidden · real details stay on this device

preview_confirmRaw.message: Send without hiding? $SITE$ will see your real details.

preview_quickOffer.message: Skip this preview next time? Turn on Quick mode.

block_title.message: This looks like $TYPE$. It won't be sent.

block_body.message: Secrets like this can give others access to your accounts.

restore_hover.message: Put back on your device. $SITE$ saw $PLACEHOLDER$.

error_pageChanged.message: MIRAGE can't protect this page right now. Your prompts are not being checked.

popup_unsupported.message: Not supported on this site yet

popup_week.message: $HIDDEN$ details hidden · $BLOCKED$ secrets stopped this week

popup_clearConfirm.message: Clear all saved details? Older replies will show placeholders.

welcome_headline.message: MIRAGE hides your personal details from AI chatbots.

welcome_done.message: You're protected on ChatGPT and Gemini.

popup_quickModeHint.message: Skip the preview and send right away.

popup_safeWordsHint.message: Never hidden, even if they look personal.

popup_alwaysHideHint.message: Names or words to hide every time.

welcome_pin.message: Pin MIRAGE to your toolbar, so you can see it's on.
